query: Can I check my traffic tickets online somewhere?
reference_answer:
Traffic Violation History:
To view your traffic violation history online, visit the Tamil Nadu Police Department's official website or the e-Challan portal. Click on "Check Traffic Violation" and enter your vehicle number or driving license number to access your records.
answer: Without access to specific information, I can't confirm if traffic tickets are available online. However, many jurisdictions offer online tracking services for traffic violations. Check with your local DMV or visit their website for official details. [Document 1]
